meta.title: Developer sign-up · Clafina
meta.description: Ask for access to the Clafina API. Tell us what you are building and we will help you get started with keys, webhooks and the MCP server.

title: Build on Clafina.
lede: Tell us what you want to build. We will set you up with API access and point you to what you need.

expect.title: Keys that do only their job
expect.body: API keys are scoped to the permissions you need and shown in full only once.

expect.title: Events as they happen
expect.body: Outgoing webhooks are signed, retried and logged, and you can replay a failed delivery.

expect.title: Someone to ask
expect.body: We answer your questions about the API while you build.

fields.name: Your name
fields.industry: Which trade is your project for?
fields.teamSize: How many people are on your team?
fields.message: What do you want to build? (optional)

form.slotHint: For example: weekday mornings, Accra time.
